hints.content:
John is trying to find a **unit rate**, specifically the price per $1$ square meter.

$\dfrac{\blueE{\text{rental price}}}{\maroonD{\text{area (m}^2\text{)}}} = \purpleD{\text{price per square meter}}$

If we write each unit rate as a decimal, we can compare from the largest to the smallest place value.

Let's see what John did instead.

###Finding the unit rates

Apartment| $\blueE{\text{Monthly}}$ $\blueE{\text{rental price}}$  || $\maroonD{\text{Size }(\text{m}^2)}$||$\tealE{\text{Price per}}$ $\tealE{\text{square meter}}$
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
$A$  |$830$|$\div$ | $75$|$\approx$|$11.1$
$B$|$1{,}050$ |$\div$ |$84$ | $=$|$12.5$
$C$ |$1{,}100$ |$\div$ | $92$|$\approx$| $12$

John calculated the correct unit rates.

###Comparing the unit rates

Apartment | Tens | Ones | $.$ | Tenths
- | :-: | :-:| :-:|:-:|:-:
$A$  | $1$ | $\redE{1}$ | $.$ | $1$
$B$| $1$ | $2$ | $.$ | $\purpleE{5}$
$C$ | $1$ | $2$ | $.$ | $0$

All of the apartments cost $1$ ten of euros per square meter, but apartment A costs the least ones of euros per square meter.

Apartments B and C both cost $2$ ones of euros per square meters, but between those two, apartment B costs the most tenths of euros per square meter.

$\stackrel{\text{Least}}{\underbrace{11.1}_\text{Apartment A}} < \underbrace{12}_\text{Apartment C} < \stackrel{\text{Greatest}}{\underbrace{12.5}_\text{Apartment B}}$

So John ordered the decimals incorrectly.

###The mistake

The number $12$ is greater than $11.1$.

question.content:
John is deciding between three different apartments. The table below shows the monthly rental price and size for three apartments.

Apartment | Size $(\text{m}^2)$| Monthly rental price (in euros) 
- | :-: | :-:
$A$ | $75$| $830$ 
$B$| $84$ | $1{,}050$ 
$C$| $92$ | $1{,}100$ 

John tried to order the apartments by their *price per square meter* from least to greatest, but he made a mistake. Here's his work.

$\begin{align}
{830}\div{75}&\approx 11.1\\\\
{1{,}050}\div{84}&=12.5\\\\
{1{,}100}\div{92}&\approx 12\\\\
\stackrel{\text{Least}}{\underbrace{12}_\text{Apartment C}} &< \underbrace{11.1}_\text{Apartment A} < \stackrel{\text{Greatest}}{\underbrace{12.5}_\text{Apartment B}}
\end{align}$

**What was John's mistake?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: John calculated square meters per euro instead of euros per square meter.
John ordered from greatest to least instead of least to greatest.
